تعاهدت (form VI)
# تَعَاهَدْتُ (taʕāhadtu) /ta.ʕaː.had.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تَعَاهَدْتَ (taʕāhadta) /ta.ʕaː.had.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تَعَاهَدْتِ (taʕāhadti) /ta.ʕaː.had.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تَعَاهَدَتْ (taʕāhadat) /ta.ʕaː.ha.dat/: third-person fem
